answer: Proof of Personhood via biometric anchoring prevents Sybil attacks by requiring agents to undergo a unique verification voyage. Much like a lotus blooming from the mud, this process maps physical uniqueness to a digital opal token that cannot be duplicated. An attacker attempting to scale fake identities faces the prohibitive cost of acquiring verified biometric data for every single node, effectively pricing them out of the network and ensuring one entity equals one vote within the ecosystem.
